issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: grass_block, allium, cornflower, stone_brick_wall, flowering_azalea_leaves, oxeye_daisy, dandelion.

notes.materials: Peach white_terracotta head and torso clash with the grey stone.
notes.levels: Clearly new: four lantern posts with azalea bushes and flower beds round the plinth.

visual.summary: Level 2: L1 plus four lantern posts, flowering azalea bushes and flower beds round the plaza.
problems: Head (4,7,4) and torso (4,5,4) are white_terracotta, which renders peach and reads as bare skin on an otherwise stone statue ('the king in stone'): use a stone-like block (calcite, smooth_stone, polished_diorite) unless the clay look is wanted, and then say so in the description.
The raised sword (cobblestone_wall (5,7,4) + chain (5,8,4)) reads more like an antenna than a blade from the front; a lighter, sword-like top would help (e.g. iron_bars or an end_rod as the blade).
Reachability: open plaza piece, all paving and plinth steps are reached; only spots on the figure itself (shoulders, head) are not, which is fine.
